punchline: He swore twenty-three push-ups was his absolute limit, then did ten more when asked.
thirty_sec: In Robin Sharma's fable, Julian tells his old colleague John to do push-ups until he truly can't do another. John collapses at twenty-three. 'Do ten more,' Julian says, and John does. Julian's teacher in the Himalayas had done the same to him: the only limits on your life are the ones you set. In the fable, a sumo wrestler stands for kaizen, constant improvement.
